body:
Hello, friend!

Summer has come, and the roads out of the valley are open and dry. You can walk all the way to the farm, the lake, even the sea!

But walkers need signposts. Come to my workshop, and we'll paint some together.
summary: Paint words on the signposts with Mr. Amos.

tasks.where: in Mr. Amos's workshop in the village
at the coop by your house
from the jug in your kitchen
